services.name: Full Legs Waxing
services.description: This is probably one of the most thorough waxing that needs to be done when compared to other body areas. Full leg waxing needs to be done when the hairs are long enough. This 45 Minute service will take the hair off from the bikini line to the toes using the Lycon hard wax system to leave you with soft, smooth skin that will result in beautiful soft skin.

services.name: Brozilian Waxing BnP II (Sack & Crack)
services.description: It has never been more enticing to keep it all clean in the genital area. It’s the new craze and everyone is doing it.During a 30-minute BnP II waxing appointment, pre-wax oil will be used to soften even the most coarse hair before the Lycon hard wax system is employed to leave you with smooth skin.

services.name: Chest & Stomach Waxing
services.description: If you’re a man who doesn’t want to have hair on your chest or stomach, but you no longer want to have to shave or deal with stubble, now is the time to schedule a chest and stomach waxing session with one of our experts. Over the course of 45-minutes, your technician will remove all of the hair from your collar bone to just below your navel using a disposable cartridge to dispense soft wax directly onto your skin. You’ll enjoy smooth skin with no itchy regrowth between sessions.

services.name: Full Back Waxing
services.description: Due to its location on the body, back hair is nearly impossible to completely remove at home. Men who don’t want to have any back hair find that our full back waxing service is the ultimate solution. During a 30-minute session, your skilled technician will dispense soft wax directly onto your skin using a disposable cartridge. All hair will be taken off of the region from your shoulders to your lower back, leaving you with stubble-free skin for weeks.

services.name: Underarm Waxing for Men
services.description: There are a variety of reasons for men to have their under arms waxed. Some are involved in sports, such as swimming, that require as little body hair as possible, while others prefer to be hair-free for purely aesthetic reasons. If you’re interested in having your underarms waxed so you can stop shaving, one of our expert technicians will be happy to assist you. During your 15-minute appointment, a pre-wax oil treatment will be applied to make sure the hair is soft.

services.name: Brozilian Men's Waxing (All Off)
services.description: Brazilian-style waxes aren’t just for the girls! Our Brozilian treatment was specially created for men and will leave your skin smooth and free of uncomfortable regrowth. During your 30-minute treatment, a pre-wax oil treatment will be applied to soften hair prior to the use of the Lycon hard wax system. Your technician will remove all hair from the shaft and sack areas. Your skin will be soft and have no stubble for several weeks, promising a significantly more pleasant experience than shaving.

services.name: Eyebrow Thread & Tweeze
services.description: Your eyebrows have a major impact on the overall look of your face; if they are the wrong shape, it can negatively affect your self-confidence. For those who are interested in completely redefining how their brows look, we offer a 15-minute eyebrow thread and tweeze service. Your skilled therapist will use both threading and tweezing techniques to leave you with perfectly shaped eyebrows you can be proud of!

services.name: Full Face Threading
services.description: Some people choose to shave or tweeze multiple facial areas, which can lead to ingrown hairs and undesirable regrowth in more than one place. If this describes your situation, our 60-minute full face threading service is the right choice for you. During your appointment, one of our skilled technicians will thread your upper and lower lip areas, cheeks, sideburns, chin region, and eyebrows to remove even the finest, silkiest hairs.

services.name: Eyebrow Lamination
services.description: If you’ve always wanted glossier, fuller brows, our new brow lamination service is your new secret weapon. Eyebrow lamination is a non-invasive procedure that will leave you with thicker, fuller, shinier brows that will enhance your appearance. Eyebrow lamination involves a painless three-step process to straighten eyebrow hairs, ultimately filling-in sparse areas and leaving clients with gorgeous brows that will ensure every outfit and make-up look really pops! The service needs to be performed approximately every 90 days for best results.

services.name: Brazilian Laser x6 ($1380 - 40% Off)
services.description: Many women prefer to have completely smooth skin in their genital regions. If this describes your preference, you are a good candidate for our BnP IV (Brazilian) laser hair removal service. During a 30-minute session, all of the hair from the genital area, including the labia and crack will be removed with a painless Alma Soprano laser. Over the course of about six sessions, your technician will use SHP IN-Motion technology to leave you with the best possible results. Free patch test.

Our full leg hair removal sessions last 60 minutes and involve the use of a painless white-light emitting laser. Your technician will use SHR IN-Motion technology to provide you with the best results for your skin color and hair color. You can expect to undergo six to eight treatments.

services.name: Consultation x Patch test (Lash Lift)
services.description:
A consultation is a one to one talk, Here I will find out important and confidential information that will help you and I to give you your desire look.

  
  
If you have experienced or suspect any allergic reactions with ANY skin products or if you have very sensitive skin - It is highly recommended to do a patch test prior to booking an appointment. The importance of patch testing is to avoid a reaction that will take a few days if not weeks to clear up. You are way better off testing a small patch on your neck and reacting there than have it all over your face.  
If you do have any concerns - it is always better to make sure.

services.name: Microneedling Facial
services.description:
Microneedling , Enzyme Mask , LED Therapy & Hydrojelly Mask. Not Recommended for first time clients.What is Microneedling? It's a Collagen Induction Therapy (the skins own ability to repair itself) . Creating a controlled induction of the skin’s self-repair process by making deliberate micro injuries to the skin. This then creates and triggers the release of growth factors for the production of new collagen and elastin, which what we lose as we age.  
Microneedling is a non-invasive treatment which gives your skin that glow & even texture you’ re looking for. It targets fine lines, wrinkles, texture, stretch marks, loss of tone and elasticity, enlarged pores, acne scarring and pigmentation. Can be performed on different areas of the body . Do not use any Alpha Hydroxy Acids, Beta Hydroxy Acid, Retinol (Vitamin A), Vitamin C (in a low pH formula) or anything perceived as ‘active’ skincare for at least 7 days post-treatment.  
Avoid extended periods in the sun and apply an SPF when you leave the house  
Do not go swimming for at least 24 hours post-treatment.  
No exercising or strenuous activity for the first 24 hours post-treatment. Sweating and gym environments are harmful, rife with bacteria, and may cause adverse reactions

services.name: Plasma Fibroblast Eye Area Treatment
services.description:
Plasma-based cosmetic treatments have been around for some time. But the “plasma” we’re referring to has nothing to do with the liquid found in your bloodstream.

Plasma refers to a stream of free electrons and positively charged ions. It is created when a gas is heated to a very high temperature. The molecules in the gas are highly charged, and the molecules split apart to release the ions and electrons. This plasma has been found to offer exceptionally amazing cosmetic benefits and is particularly helpful in battling signs of aging. This is the method of fibroblast tightening. The tiny burns that develop superficially, cause your old dermal cells and skin proteins to disintegrate. This constant exposure to the plasma arch for the duration of the treatment forces your skin to get rid of old cells and regenerate fresh skin cells. When this happens, the old, sagging skin is disintegrated slowly and fresh, younger-looking, smoother skin grows in its place. This entire process is also called Fibroblast because the plasma pen targets the skin cells called fibroblasts, which produce collagen and elastin in the skin.

services.name: Luxury Vajacial
services.description:
A "Vajacial" Yes, there is a facial for your vagina. 

We take care of our face, why not do the same for the most intimate area of the body?

What is a vajacial ?

For those of you new to the concept, the vajacial is a spa treatment performed on the vulva of the vagina. Focusing on the bikini line and outer labia. It does not actually deal with the inner vagina.

What is the purpose of a vajacial ?

A vajacial treats ingrown hairs, removes dead skin cells, smooths bumps around bikini line, prevents acne, helps with hyperpigmentation, all to maintain healthy, smooth and hydrated skin in the vaginal area.

What does the procedure consist of ?

A vajacial is typically a 50 minute treatment, which includes a cleanse, an exfoliant which can be a mild enzyme exfoliant or even a manual exfoliant, extractions of ingrown hairs, followed by a custom mask, completed with a skin brightening serum or spot treatment. A light chemical peel can also be done in this area for an additional charge.

What are some benefits of a vajacial?

Vajacials can help with evening out skin tone around the bikini and get rid of bacteria and skin-brightening treatments to lessen discoloration and hyperpigmentation. Helps with vaginal skin care, preventing irritation from waxing/shaving. Along with maintaining upkeep and promoting cosmetic benefits of the vagina, the vajacial also promotes body positivity.

What are the products used?

At Beautiology we use all natural and vegan products that help to illuminate, soothe and hydrate the areas. Your Beauty Therapist will recommend based on your needs. 

Are they for sensitive skin?

Even though this is a procedure for an intimate, more sensitive area, everyone’s area is different. Yes, this is safe for sensitive skin. A patch test will be done beforehand to ensure you will achieve maximum results...

services.name: Body Microneedling
services.description: Microneedling is a cosmetic treatment used to address skin concerns such as acne scars, wrinkles, enlarged pores, hyperpigmentation, and melasma. Not only on your face, but also stomach, body scarring and even inner thighs. It is an excellent way to restore a youthful brightness to your appearance and improve your skin firmness and tone. The procedure boosts collagen and elastin production, remodelling the skin, and lightening pigmentation. Using ultra-fine needles, a device punctures the skin, triggering the body’s natural healing process.  Since the needles are short, thin, and move over the surface quickly, the epidermis is only minimally penetrated. Once your skin heals, you will benefit from brighter, healthier looking skin, and diminished pigmentation or marking. The minimally-invasive procedure is extremely effective at breaking down hyperpigmented patches, as well as scarring in the layers of your skin.

🌵 Desert Glow Hydro Facial – Perfect for Arizona Skin

Living in Arizona means constant sun exposure, dry heat, and dehydration — and your skin feels it.

Unlike traditional facials, this treatment deeply cleanses while simultaneously infusing hydration back into the skin — which is critical in our desert climate.

In dry heat, your skin barrier becomes compromised. When that happens, you may notice:
	•	Makeup not sitting smoothly
	•	Skin feeling tight but still breaking out
	•	Dark spots lingering longer
	•	Increased sensitivity

This facial gently exfoliates away dead, sun-damaged skin while replenishing moisture, restoring balance, and strengthening your barrier.

✔ Deep hydration without heaviness
✔ Restores moisture lost from heat & sun exposure
✔ Flushes out clogged pores from sweat + SPF
✔ Helps brighten sun-induced hyperpigmentation
✔ Smooths dry texture and flaking
✔ Supports collagen in high UV climates
✔ Leaves skin plump, radiant, and balanced

Think of it as a reset button for sun-stressed skin.

⸻

🌞 Why Consistency Matters in Arizona

In extreme heat, your skin dehydrates faster than you realize — even if you drink water. Monthly hydro facials help maintain:
	•	Healthy skin barrier function
	•	Even tone despite constant UV exposure
	•	Controlled oil production
	•	Long-term glow and smoothness

This isn’t just a luxury — in Arizona, it’s maintenance.

services.name: Steam Therapy + Hair Food Infusion
services.description:
🧼 Please arrive with freshly washed hair. This service does not include shampooing.
🔬 Overview:

Recommended every 2 weeks for best results

This revitalizing treatment blends the power of professional-grade steam therapy with the nourishing benefits of my signature Hair Food oil. The steam gently opens the scalp’s pores, allowing deeper penetration of nutrients to hydrate dry, brittle, or dehydrated strands.

Ideal for those experiencing dry scalp, thinning hair, breakage, or transitioning hair, this service promotes scalp circulation, boosts follicle health, and supports long-term hair restoration and retention.

This restorative treatment blends professional-grade steam therapy with my nourishing signature Hair Food oil. It’s designed to open scalp pores, deeply hydrate, and promote healthy hair from root to tip — perfect for dry scalp, thinning, or transitioning hair.

💧 Benefits:
• Boosts circulation & moisture retention
• Supports hair density & breakage control
• Encourages deeper nutrient absorption
• Enhances scalp comfort & overall hair vitality

Client Must Arrive With Clean Hair.
Hair must be pre-washed before the appointment. Scalp will be cleansed with professional wipes before treatment.

⸻

💡 Not ready for the full Advanced Hair Growth Program?

This is a great place to start!
This treatment helps you care for your scalp while you’re getting ready to invest in the full program. It’s a smart, low-commitment step toward consistent scalp nourishment and long-term growth.

⸻

Service Protocol

Step 1: Scalp Analysis
Visual & digital inspection (optional) to assess dryness, buildup, and thinning zones.

Step 2: Scalp Prep
Gently exfoliate the scalp using esthetic wipes to remove surface residue and prep for product absorption.

Step 3: Steam Therapy
Apply a generous amount of MakeupByToni215 Hair Food directly to the scalp. Client sits under a professional hair steamer (not a heat cap) for 20 minutes to open follicles and infuse nutrients.

Step 4: Lock-in Nourishment
Cool-down phase to allow oils to settle and close follicles naturally. No rinsing required.

Step 5: Scalp Massage Enhancement
Stimulate blood flow with a vibrating or manual scalp massage tool to further support absorption and hair follicle vitality.

🏠 Home Care Kit Add-On (Optional)

Starting at $22 – includes:
	•	1 oz Scalp Detox Scrub – exfoliates flakes and buildup
	•	2 oz Hair Food Oil – hydrates and promotes growth
	•	Application instructions included
💡 Perfect for in-between treatments or self-care days. (Starting price: $45.00+)

services.name: In-Person Makeup Lesson
services.description:
We offer a private two (2) hour makeup lesson where we will show you how to do a full face from start to finish. This lesson is perfect for makeup novices, the woman who wants to improve her makeup skills, needs feedback on how to use products she already owns and recommendations on what to buy. The lesson covers the following:  
• Prepping skin for makeup  
• Perfecting skin with foundation and concealer  
• Perfecting brows  
• Proper use of makeup brushes and sponges  
• Proper application of powder, bronzers/contour, and blush  
• Bringing out your eyes using eyeshadow, eyeliner, and mascara  
• Proper application of lip liner and lipstick  
• Product and technique recommendations based on your specific skin type and facial features

We will demonstrate the techniques on one side of your face and will have you then repeat the techniques on the other side of your face while giving you feedback. We can focus on a particular technique such as a smoky-eye or winged liner. You are encouraged to bring in a picture of a particular makeup look that you want to achieve, but we will only do one complete look. We encourage you to bring your makeup bag and brushes to give you feedback on the products you already own.

** 2  follow up face time are included : to perfect your skills **

Lift & Tone Microcurrent Eye Sculpt

12 minutes 6 min per eye 

What is a Microcurrent Eye Treatment?  
RevitalEyes Microcurrent Therapy is a non-invasive lifting and firming treatment designed to sculpt, tone, and rejuvenate the delicate under-eye area. Using low-level electrical currents, this treatment stimulates muscle re-education, enhances lymphatic drainage, and promotes collagen production, leaving your eyes looking refreshed, lifted, and youthful.

How It Works:  
During the session, gentle microcurrents are applied to the orbicularis oculi muscle, delivering:  
✔ Instant muscle toning & contouring for a firmer under-eye appearance.  
✔ Increased ATP production, energizing skin cells for long-term collagen and elastin renewal.  
✔ Lymphatic drainage stimulation, reducing puffiness and fluid retention.  
✔ Smoother, hydrated skin, minimizing the look of fine lines and crepey texture.

Results:  
After the treatment, the under-eye area appears lifted, refreshed, and sculpted, with less puffiness and improved firmness. Best results are achieved with a series of treatments to retrain the muscles for long-lasting effects.

Best For:
Clients with under-eye puffiness or mild to moderate sagging.
Individuals looking for a natural eye lift without injections or downtime.
Anyone wanting smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking eyes.

services.name: RF Tightening & Brightening Eye Treatment

Radio Frequency (RF) Eye Treatment for Dark Circles

12 minutes total 6 min per eye 

What is an RF Eye Treatment for Dark Circles?

Radio Frequency (RF) therapy is a non-invasive treatment designed to reduce dark circles, tighten the skin, and improve circulation around the eyes. Using controlled thermal energy, RF stimulates collagen production and increases blood flow, helping to reduce hollowness, pigmentation, and puffiness that contribute to dark circles.

How It Works:  
During the treatment, tri-polar radio frequencies gently penetrate up to 20mm into the skin, targeting the dermis and underlying tissues. The controlled heat:  
✔ Stimulates collagen & elastin production to firm under-eye skin.  
✔ Enhances circulation, reducing stagnant blood pooling (a major cause of dark circles).  
✔ Brightens the under-eye area by improving oxygen and nutrient flow.  
✔ Reduces puffiness by encouraging lymphatic drainage.

Best For:
Clients with hollowness & thinning under-eye skin.
Individuals with dark circles caused by poor circulation or collagen loss.
Those looking for a non-invasive alternative to fillers.

services.name: Post Op Care Therapy
services.description:
*this therapy is only for my post-op clients*

If you are needing services such as lymphatic drainage therapy please schedule a phone or in person consultation to discuss a plan of care. This is included in the services. No additional charges.  

While traditional body massage can be therapeutic as well as relaxing, lymphatic drainage therapy is very different. Its purpose is to restore healthy lymph flow. Anyone may benefit from this therap to detox, relax, ease muscle soreness, reduce swelling and improve circulation.

However, here at Alamo Body Sculpting, we are especially excited about the benefits this therapy can provide my clients following surgical procedures such as Liposuction, Suture Suspension FaceLift, or Renuvion J-Plasma radiofrequency skin tightening. That’s because lymphatic drainage therapy promotes healing.

What is Lymphatic Drainage therapy?  
The lymphatic system circulates white blood cells (lymphocytes) that fight infection, and it serves as the body’s cleaning system, removing toxins and other waste. Lymph flows naturally, it’s not pumped by the heart. If the flow becomes sluggish or blocked, lymph builds up, reducing the body’s ability to function properly.

Neuromodulator treatment on the Glabella Complex is done to correct the wrinkled areas on the forehead. Glabellar or glabella lines appear in the glabella, the skin over your forehead, between and above the eyebrows, and right above the nose. When you wrinkle your face by talking, yawning, laughing, or making expressions, the glabella is the skin most affected by the muscle activity beneath the surface. This treatment is minimally invasive with little to no downtime and can last 3-5 months  
💉Brow Lift  
A Brow Lift is a procedure that gives a temporary lift to the eyebrows through the strategic use of neuromodulators. Using the injectable to relax the muscles that drag the brows down, the upward-pulling muscle of the forehead can do its thing unchecked, causing a physical lift of the brows. This can last 3-5 months. This is a more cost-effective alternative rather than going under the knife. This treatment is minimally invasive with little to no downtime.

Results take roughly 5-14 days to go into effect, No significant downtime is associated with this procedure.  
There is a chance of small bumps at the injection site, which will fade within hours.  
Botox, and how does it benefit me?  
Neurotoxins such as Xeomin are purified toxins that temporarily reduce or erase facial wrinkles.
